node.statement: Summing the coordinate inequalities over l gives n(w_i-w_k) <= n(w_i)+sum_l max(w_k(l),0). Since k is an index of the given family, w_k has coordinate sum zero; using t=max(t,0)-max(-t,0) and summing over the coordinates of w_k gives sum_l max(w_k(l),0)=sum_l max(-w_k(l),0)=n(w_k). Hence n(w_i-w_k) <= n(w_i)+n(w_k) for every i, without using node 1.4.1.
